works.reason: Plan only, not taken: no TEI exists. Public-domain copy-text: archive.org novatianiromanae00novauoft (1909, flagged NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT), with a _djvu.txt OCR layer. The OCR mixes the Latin with English side summaries, footnotes and line numbers, so it needs a cleaning pass and a hand-built chapter split (32 chapters, opening 'Regula exigit ueritatis'). Second witness: J. Jackson, Novatiani opera (London 1728), archive.org bim_eighteenth-century_novatiani-presbyteri-rom_novatianus_1728, with OCR. The intake script reads TEI only, so this needs a script change or a hand intake.
